title: Proposal: working together on Pompe disease research

sentences.text: A proposal to work together on research into Pompe disease.
We are writing to the Acid Maltase Deficiency Association because you support people and families affected by Pompe disease.
We have not met yet, and we would value your guidance.
Pompe disease is driven by a lysosomal enzyme deficiency that leads to glycogen storage inside lysosomes.
A global prospective observational Pompe registry and a registry of lysosomal storage diseases are both recruiting.
A phase 3 cipaglucosidase alfa and miglustat study in infantile-onset disease is recruiting, and a phase 3 avalglucosidase alfa study in babies is active but not recruiting.
A long-term adult study of ATB200/AT2221 in late-onset disease has completed, and a paediatric study is active but not recruiting.
One limit: the link to protein misfolding rests on laboratory work and carries only moderate confidence in the atlas.
We would propose a study on [research question about Pompe disease], shaped with your community from the start.
Its design, sites and funding are still to be settled: [study details].

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be open to discussing this idea with us?
If so, we would like to learn how your community, or the registries your members already join, might take part, always with proper consent and ethics approval.
We are not asking for any personal information about patients or families.
If this is of interest, could we arrange a short call at a time that suits you?
